title: Ageing- and ambient-robust core-temperature estimation of 21700 cells, validated on embedded thermocouples (two labs)
datasets: WMG core-temperature ageing (Mendeley bf6fksxpp2, CC BY 4.0: 3 instrumented + 3 pristine LG M50, 550 cycles, 1 Hz, core and surface T) + TU Berlin internal temperature (DepositOnce 25110, CC BY 4.0: 3 LG M50LT, 12 drive cycles x 5 ambient T). Optional: LG HG2 / Panasonic for surface-T-only pre-training.
physics: Two-state lumped thermal model (core/surface): C_c dT_c/dt = Q - (T_c - T_s)/R_c ; C_s dT_s/dt = (T_c - T_s)/R_c - (T_s - T_amb)/R_u. Heat Q = I (U_ocv - V) + I T dU_ocv/dT (irreversible + entropic), U_ocv(SOC) from pseudo-OCV/RPT; R_c, R_u, C_c, C_s learnable (Arrhenius / ageing dependence of internal resistance through heat generation). Quasi-steady Biot relation T_c = T_s + G (T_s - T_amb) as the minimum physics baseline.
predicts: Core temperature trajectory T_c(t) (hidden state) and the thermal parameters (R_c, C_c, R_u, C_s) per cell and ageing stage, with uncertainty.
supervision: Supervised by V, I, T_s (all cells) and T_c on training instrumented cells; physics residual on the non-instrumented cells (unlabelled collocation). Held out: one instrumented cell (leave-one-cell-out), late-ageing blocks, and the TU Berlin ambient temperatures never seen in training.
why_not_dd: Core temperature is unmeasurable in a production cell, so a black box can only be trained on a handful of drilled cells and must extrapolate to other ambients, ageing states and cells; the thermal ODE constrains the dynamics, exposes identifiable parameters, and lets unlabelled cells contribute through the residual.
compute: JAX or PyTorch, CPU is enough (1 Hz, few states). Effort: 10-14 weeks to a submission (2 w data pipeline incl. MATLAB-table conversion, 3 w models + baselines, 3 w OOD/ablation, 3 w writing).
done: PINN / physics-guided core-temperature estimators exist (INTELEC 2025, IECON 2025 PINN-KAN, Batteries 2026 PI-TCN-LSTM, TTE 2025 physics-guided Bi-LSTM, TTE 2026 PGNN field reconstruction, Applied Energy 2026 ultrahigh-rate PINN); classical observers and EIS-based estimation are mature (JPS 2014, TSTE 2015). Several papers validate on their own lab thermocouples; many train on simulated core temperature (e.g. TTE 2022 hybrid ECM-LSTM used an electrothermal model to generate data).
not_done: No abstract read uses two independent embedded-sensor datasets, ageing over 550 cycles and five ambients with leave-one-cell-out splits; none reports against the quasi-steady Biot baseline; none uses non-instrumented cells as physics-residual collocation.
gap: A core-temperature estimator whose accuracy is demonstrated, against embedded thermocouples, across cells, ageing and ambient temperature it never saw, and that beats both the Biot quasi-steady relation and a two-state Kalman observer.
sat_evidence: 139 OpenAlex hits for (physics-informed/guided/hybrid) x core/internal temperature, 40 of them in 2026 (fast growth); only 22 hits mention embedded/instrumented thermocouples and 19 combine core temperature with ageing. A withdrawn 2026 Zenodo record (abstract indexed by OpenAlex, landing page now HTTP 410) reported that a calibrated quasi-steady relation reached 0.13 K RMSE and that an inverse PINN was less accurate on LG M50 embedded-sensor data: a strong warning that the physics baseline may already be enough.
verdict: SURVIVES, with a hard kill criterion (must beat the Biot relation and a 2-state KF on held-out cells).

title: PINN SOC estimation (incl. cross-temperature electro-thermal ECM) on McMaster / CALCE drive-cycle data
datasets: LG HG2 (cp3473x7xv), Panasonic 18650PF (wykht8y7tg), CALCE INR18650-20R / A123 drive cycles.
physics: 1RC/2RC ECM ODEs with Coulomb counting, OCV(SOC,T), Arrhenius R(T); optionally lumped thermal state.
supervision: V, I, T; SOC by Coulomb counting; hold out drive cycles and temperatures.
why_not_dd: Cross-temperature extrapolation and robustness to sensor noise.
done: Dozens of PINN-SOC papers on exactly these files, incl. LG HG2 cross-temperature with three seeds (Batteries 2026, MAE 2.33 %), TL-PINN cross-temperature (JES/JECS 2026), Energy Storage Materials 2022 (281 citations).
not_done: Little left beyond incremental architectures; the datasets have one cell each, so no cell-level split is possible.
gap: None that a Q1 reviewer would accept as new on these files.

title: PINN SOH / capacity-fade estimation across protocols (XJTU, Severson, Tongji, CALCE)
datasets: XJTU (Zenodo 10963339), Severson (matr.io), Tongji (Zenodo 6405084), CALCE CS2/CX2, NASA.
physics: Empirical degradation laws (power-law / Arrhenius) and state-space capacity dynamics as residuals.
why_not_dd: Small data and transfer across chemistries.
done: Wang et al. Nat. Commun. 2024 (PINN, 387 cells, MAPE 0.87 %, 957 citations in Consensus) on XJTU+Tongji+MIT+HUST; JES 2026 DT-PINN random charging segments; Energy 2025 generic PINN; MSSP 2022; JPS 2023.
not_done: Only incremental variants remain on these datasets.
gap: None of substance on the popular datasets.

title: Physics-constrained ageing law (SEI sqrt-t calendar + throughput/Arrhenius cycle) extrapolating to unseen temperature and DoD
datasets: Sandia (Preger 2020; NCA/NMC/LFP x T x DoD x rate) and ISU-ILCC (238 NMC pouch, 63 conditions) via Battery Archive; CALCE PLN storage (144 cells, 4 T x 3 SOC) for calendar ageing.
physics: dQ_loss/dt = k_cal(T,SOC) / (2 sqrt(t)) + k_cyc(T,C-rate,DoD) |I|; k = k0 exp(-Ea/R (1/T - 1/Tref)); Tafel SOC dependence; knee via lithium-plating term. NN learns residual corrections and condition embeddings while monotonicity and Arrhenius structure are enforced.
predicts: Capacity trajectory per cell, kinetic parameters (Ea, k0), knee onset.
supervision: Capacity checks; hold out whole temperatures / DoD levels / chemistries (leave-one-condition-out).
why_not_dd: Lifetime tests never cover the deployment grid; extrapolation in temperature is exactly where black boxes break and where Arrhenius structure helps.
done: PiDDM (arXiv 2026) puts Arrhenius SEI kinetics into training on XJTU 55 cells (time extrapolation, last 10 %); Sci. Rep. 2026 calibration-free PIML degradation; IFAC 2023 SEI optimal experiment design; Energy 2025 generic PINN.
not_done: No abstract read extrapolates to an unseen temperature or DoD level held out as a whole condition across Sandia/ISU-ILCC chemistries; calendar + cycle decomposition on public multi-chemistry data is rare.
gap: Leave-one-temperature-out and leave-one-DoD-out capacity-fade prediction with an Arrhenius/sqrt-t structured hybrid across three chemistries.
sat_evidence: 49 OpenAlex hits, 33 in 2026 (accelerating but still small).
verdict: SURVIVES. Risk: Sandia temperature grid is coarse (3 levels), so 'unseen temperature' tests have few points.

title: Health-aware electro-thermal ECM evolution learned from random-walk EV-like loads (NASA Randomized Usage)
datasets: NASA Randomized Battery Usage RW1-RW28 (S3 mirror): random-walk 0.5-5 A loads, 3 load distributions, room T and 40 C; reference capacity, 15 W and pulse tests every 50 RW cycles.
physics: 1RC/2RC ECM: V = U_ocv(z) - R0(T,h) I - v1, dv1/dt = -v1/(R1 C1) + I/C1, dz/dt = -I/Q(h); Arrhenius R(T); lumped thermal m c dT/dt = I^2 R0 + I v1 - hA (T - T_amb); slow health state h (capacity, R0) evolving with Ah throughput and temperature (monotone).
predicts: Per-cycle health state (capacity Q, R0, R1, C1) from operating data only, plus SOC and temperature trajectories.
supervision: V, I, T from random-walk discharges (all cycles); reference capacity and pulse-derived R0/RC every 50 cycles used ONLY for validation (or sparse supervision ablation). Held out: whole cells, load distributions, ambient (room vs 40 C).
why_not_dd: Capacity labels exist only every 50 cycles (13 points per cell): a black-box SOH regressor has almost nothing to learn from, whereas the ECM residual on every random-walk second carries information on Q and R0. The physics also transfers across load distributions and temperature.
compute: 1 GPU or CPU; 1.07 GB data; 10-14 weeks.
done: Bole 2014 adapted an electrochemistry model to this data; event-window Transformer on RW9-11 (J. Phys. Energy 2026, R2 0.955, MAE 2.39 on held-out RW11); deep-learning SOH (JES 2020, 414 citations); ARX RUL (RESS 2024); JES 2026 'Physics-informed learning of health-aware ECM parameter evolution' (abstract not available, dataset unknown); JECS 2025 aging-sensitive ECM for knee.
not_done: No abstract read learns ECM-thermal health states from the random-walk operation itself and validates them against the independent pulse/reference tests, across all 7 load/temperature groups.
gap: Label-free tracking of capacity and resistance from random EV-like loads, with the reference tests used only as held-out ground truth, and transfer across load distributions and ambient temperature.
sat_evidence: Only 56 OpenAlex hits for the dataset family (20 in 2026) and 26 for physics-informed ECM-parameter ageing; the closest method paper (JES 2026) could not be read.
verdict: SURVIVES (best novelty/feasibility balance). Must read JES 2026 (10.1016/j.est.2026.125097) in full before committing.

title: Physics-informed pack resistance / capacity tracking on real EV field data
datasets: Stanford Joule 2023 field data (CC BY-NC 3.0, 1 vehicle, 1 year), Korean E-GMP fleet telemetry (IEEE DataPort subscription, 21 EVs), BMW i3 72 trips (CC BY 4.0, login).
physics: Pack ECM + lumped thermal + Arrhenius resistance; capacity fade law.
supervision: BMS V, I, T, SoC; no ground-truth capacity (except vendor SoH / one lab resistance in the Korean set).
why_not_dd: No labels in the field; physics gives the only consistency check.
done: TIE 2026 laboratory-to-field physics-informed domain adaptation (RMSE < 2 %); TII 2026 cross-vehicle physics-guided residual learning; Applied Energy 2026 fragmented charging segments in fleets; TL-PINN 2026 transfer to vehicle data.
not_done: Field validation against independent capacity measurements is almost absent (no labels).
gap: Field-data ageing estimates checked against an independent reference test.
sat_evidence: 379 broad hits (135 in 2026); the specific physics-informed field-SOH niche is newer but growing.
verdict: RUNNER-UP (best Q1 fit, weakest ground truth and licences).

title: Physics-informed PMSM rotor/stator temperature (Paderborn)
datasets: Paderborn electric motor temperature (Kaggle, CC BY-SA 4.0, 185 h, 2 Hz).
physics: Lumped-parameter thermal network (LPTN) with loss model (copper I^2R(T), iron losses ~ f, B).
why_not_dd: Rotor temperature unmeasurable in vehicles; interpretability.
done: Kirchgaessner et al.: deep residual NNs (TPEL 2021) and Thermal Neural Networks = LPTN + NN (EAAI 2023, MSE 3.18 K^2, worst 5.84 K, 64 parameters); interpretability of TNN (Automotive Innovation 2026); transfer-learning shared-node TNN (TIE 2026); PINN under sparse sampling (Energies 2026); ATE 2026 PINN hot-spot forecasting; OLTEM (AI 2025).
not_done: Single motor, so cross-machine generalisation cannot be tested.
gap: None on this dataset that would beat the TNN line in a Q1 venue.
sat_evidence: 52 hits in the narrow probe, 21 in 2026, and the dataset owners already published the physics-informed solution.

title: Fault-model-informed estimation of PMSM inter-turn short-circuit severity
datasets: HUST PMSM-ITSC (IEEE DataPort subscription, 66.9 GB, 3-ph V and I, short-circuit current, 12 torque-speed points, 9 turn % x 3 fault resistances); Jung et al. Mendeley (current + vibration only).
physics: dq model with shorted-turn branch: extra state i_f, fault ratio mu and fault resistance R_f; negative-sequence and 2f signatures.
supervision: HUST measures i_f -> can validate the hidden state.
why_not_dd: Severity across operating points and motors; unmeasured fault current.
done: CM-FMINN fault-model-informed PMSM multi-fault (TIE 2026); physics-informed domain adaptation for synchronous machines (Energies 2026); co-simulation residuals (SAFEPROCESS 2025).
not_done: Estimating the fault current itself and validating it against the measured i_f.
gap: Hidden fault-current and resistance identification validated on measured short-circuit current.
sat_evidence: 13 hits, 11 in 2026: new but suddenly active.
verdict: ON HOLD (data access: subscription + 67 GB; Mendeley set lacks voltages).

title: Physics-informed IGBT/MOSFET ageing prognostics (NASA)
datasets: NASA IGBT (6 devices, 240 MB), NASA MOSFET (7.85 GB, reference doc offline).
physics: Vce,on / Rds,on thermal drift, Coffin-Manson / Norris-Landzberg.
done: TPEL 2025 physics-informed DL with sparse data; ICPHM 2024 MOSFET RUL; Sensors J. 2026 physics-guided autoformer.

title: Physics-informed charging-session modelling (ACN-Data)
physics: CC-CV taper of an unknown battery; pilot-signal limits.
predicts: Vehicle SOC at arrival / battery capacity from current taper.
done: Physics-informed RL for charging coordination (PESGM 2026, TSG 2026, TTE 2025).
not_done: Battery-state inference from station current taper.
verdict: REJECT (no ground truth for the physics claim).

title: Sensor-fault vs process-fault separation with whitened physics residuals on a real grid-tied PV inverter (GPVS-Faults)
datasets: GPVS-Faults (Mendeley n76t439f65, CC BY 4.0, MPPT/IPPT, inverter IGBT fault, feedback-sensor fault, sag, shading, open circuit).
physics: PV single-diode model, DC-link energy balance C v dv/dt = P_pv - P_grid, inverter dq current dynamics; residual whitening and fault-signature directions.
predicts: Residuals, fault class, sensor-vs-process attribution, fault magnitude.
supervision: Fault labels used only for evaluation; residual models fitted on healthy runs.
why_not_dd: Classifiers learn the lab's fault set; physics residuals generalise to unseen magnitudes and tell a wrong sensor from a wrong process.
compute: Light; 8-12 weeks (the user already has a simulated version).
done: Model-based FDI for PV inverters (IET PE 2019, TPEL 2017), SMO sensor-fault diagnosis (Sustainability 2025), frugal physics-informed fusion on simulated PV (HAL 2026).
not_done: Physics-residual separation of sensor faults from process faults on this real dataset.
gap: Sensor/process fault attribution on measured grid-tied PV data with physics residuals instead of a classifier.
sat_evidence: 76 broad hits (30 in 2026); few combine physics residuals and sensor-vs-process attribution on GPVS.
verdict: SURVIVES (outside EV priority; transferable to traction-inverter sensor faults).

title: Physics-constrained impedance ageing: joint HPPC/EIS-ECM parameter trajectories for SOH and degradation modes
datasets: Stanford Pozzato 2022 (10 LG M50T, UDDS, HPPC + EIS 0.01 Hz-10 kHz at 3 SOC, OSF, licence to confirm); Cambridge EIS (Zhang 2020, CC BY); Tongji impedance (CC BY); relaxation-EIS 2026 (3 cells, 15-45 C).
physics: Randles / transmission-line ECM with Kramers-Kronig consistency, DRT positivity, Arrhenius temperature dependence of R_ct, links R_SEI growth to capacity loss.
predicts: ECM parameters vs ageing, capacity, degradation-mode indicators.
supervision: EIS/HPPC + capacity; hold out cells and SOC levels.
why_not_dd: Interpretability and consistency of impedance; few cells.
done: RSER 2023 physics-informed DL with EIS (59 citations); JES 2025 PINN degradation diagnosis via EIS; JES 2026 multi-temperature PI transfer learning; 2026 relaxation-to-EIS kinetics-informed NN.
not_done: Joint use of HPPC and EIS on drive-cycle-aged cells with leave-cell-out validation.
gap: Physically consistent impedance-ageing trajectories validated across cells of a drive-cycle ageing campaign.
